full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: I'm looking for a string of pearls for my wife .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Yes , sir . What price range do you have in mind ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: I'm not sure . I don't know very much about the price of pearls .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I see . Let me show you some samples of various qualities . This one is very nice . It's three hundred and fifty dollars .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Is there a price reduction ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: We are having a sale now . The price has already gone down .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: How much is that one ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: It's two hundred and eighty dollars .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: OK . I'll take it . Thank you .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Please tell me something about your insurance background .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I majored in international banking at college so I took many insurance courses . And I worked at an insurance company for my graduation field work .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Why do you want to be an insurance agent ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I care about people and I know the importance of insurance .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Do you have any work experience in promotion ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Yes , I do . I have worked as a salesman for P & G Company Ltd .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Do people respond well to you ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Yes , I'm good with people .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: We've managed to reduce our energy consumption in our factory by about 15 per cent in the last two years .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: That's excellent . How have you managed that ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Mainly because we've invested in a heat recovery system .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: What does that mean exactly ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Well , we use the exhaust gases from our printing presses to provide energy to heat our dryers .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: What other sources of energy do you use ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: We don't use any fossil fuels . Most of our power comes from hydro-electric plants . We're hoping to use even more energy from alternative sources in the future - perhaps even wind power .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Have you ever tried shopping online ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: No , never . I prefer to actually see and touch what I'm buying before I pay for it , especially for clothes and shoes .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: That's right . Seeing is believing .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I've heard some friends say when they get the article , it's quite different from what they see on the website advertisement .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: That happens . Without close quality examination , we may encounter fraud , and the e-shop may suddenly disappear .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: What's more , it's not always so safe for us to pay online as hackers might steal the user name and password .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: It's said that some measures have been taken to deal with this problem . Paying online is much safer than before , but I still have the feeling that it's not safe enough .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I can't agree more . that's why I only do street shopping .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Me too . Sometimes I surf online shops to check some related information , and then go to a physical store to do the actual shopping .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: That's a good idea .

B prefers seeing and touching purchases before paying, especially clothes and shoes.
B only shops in physical shops because B considers online payment insufficiently safe.
B has heard friends report discrepancies between online advertisements and delivered goods.

review_rows.claim: B expressed the principle that seeing is believing, indicating a preference for seeing products in person before purchasing
B mentioned encountering fraud or an e-shop suddenly disappearing while shopping online

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Have you seen this news article ? Apparently an organization has made a list to name the new seven wonders of the world and people could vote for them online .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Wow , that's really interesting . So who won ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Well , the Great Wall of China , the Taj Mahal in India .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I've been there ! It really is an amazing work of architecture and art . The entire complex is made of white marble and in the interior of the tomb , the walls are covered with gems and emeralds !

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Cool ! Also amongst the winners is Petra , in Jordan , Mach Pitch in Peru and the pyramid in Chichenitza in Mexico .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Wait a minute ! It also says that the Christ Re-deemer statue in Brazil and the Colosseum in Rome are wonders . I would love to go to Italy and see the Colosseum , stand in the middle like a gladiator !

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Well , let's see if we can find some cheap airfare and we can go towards the end of the year .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Good idea !
